desc:
👍 THUMBS UP for more UPDATES and a FREE CODE at 50,000 LIKES 👍

🖥️ PC Controls:

E or Click - Pickup / Place candy
F - Drop candy
Numbers - Switch candy
T - Unlock Mouse
G - Magic Ability
Hold Click - Eat / Collect candy

🎮 Controller Controls:

RT - Pickup / Place candy
LT - Drop candy
Upgrades - U
Hold LT - Collect candy

🍭 Your local candy shop has been turned upside down and sweets are scattered everywhere! Become the ultimate candy collector and help clean up the chaos by sorting thousands of delicious treats hidden around the entire shop!

👥 Clean up the candy shop alone or with friends!
🏁 Race for the fastest cleanup times on the leaderboard!
🔓 Unlock upgrades and magical abilities to collect sweets faster!

✨ Inspired by cute cleanup, collecting, and candy games ✨
